actual_scope: On the exact PR2093 ordinary-source h witness, retain the PR2216 A-to-T shear and add one common-frame, sum-preserving tap X_21 += X_2; Y_21 -= X_2. Replay through the complete retained QQ16 tail and verify the eight PR2216 directions remain rank eight at the B1 cut.
scope_change_reason: The generic QQ16 fixed-pair and centre/coverage alternatives have direct overlap. This is a distinct, single-port state change that reuses an already-live ordinary field, combines the PR2093 hidden h trajectory with PR2216 state shear, and adds no observation or recursive child. It tests a new interface mechanism rather than rechecking either predecessor witness.
bottleneck_link: PR2093 exhibits a nonzero ordinary-source input whose selected state and all retained observations vanish under the unchanged F0/B1 path. This tap exposes that exact input in selected outputs through the retained tail, while keeping the prior eight-direction B1 rank result.
stop_rule: The exact h support is only U ports 2, 8, and 85. Screen its 3 x 8 one-source/one-T-pair taps at B1; stop on the first tap that survives the complete retained tail. Do not expand to multi-port taps or claim full-controller injectivity. Stop immediately if a new recursive child or frame transition is required.
evidence: RESULT.json and verify.py reproduce the exact full-tail endpoint; verify_b1_tap.py preserves the PR2216 eight-direction B1 rank result. Scope, cost, sources and limitations are in README.md.
